part.text:
Fixed and verified. The bug was in `src/syntax_mapping.rs:119`: `--map-syntax` globs were compiled with `case_insensitive(false)`, so `*.config` didn't match `NuGet.Config`. Changed it to `case_insensitive(true)` so pattern matching is case-insensitive (matching upstream fix for issue #2520 / PR #2650).

All tests pass: the FAIL_TO_PASS regression test `highlighting_independant_from_map_syntax_case`, plus lib (47), integration (125), snapshot (27), and other test suites.
